title: Artifact header (standard front-matter block) v0.1
description: The standard front-matter header block carried at the top of every governed artifact in a vercy-family meta-model: every Finding file, layer file, bundle README and root doc. It is the artifact-level face of ARCH-002 (versioning and lifecycle) and CON-6 (versioning and change history), and its change_history is append-only per IC-8: entries are added, never rewritten or removed, so the header is itself the artifact's memory. Identity is a stable ARCH-003 identifier: the paired naming rule (a candidate ARCH-003 clause, see registry/conventions/README.md CR-A) is that filenames carry the stable identifier and semantic name only and dates SHALL NOT appear in filenames; the date, the authors and the change history live in this header block. Superseding an artifact does not rename its file: it flips status and appends a change_history entry, preserving the ARCH-009 fingerprint over canonical form. This schema validates offline (no remote references) so registry CI can run it without network access. It is a reusable standard artifact, not tied to any one model. Cites ARCH-002, ARCH-003, ARCH-009, IC-8, CON-6.

id.description: Stable ARCH-003 identifier of the artifact, publisher- or namespace-prefixed, lowercase, dot/slash/hyphen separated (for example collmm.02-membership or collmm/model/02-membership). Never reused and never rewritten. Per the CR-A naming clause it carries no date and no version: time and authorship live only in change_history. The id, title and status fields are IC-4 adjacent and do not ride the auto-approval lane.

status.description: Lifecycle status per ARCH-002. draft: authored, not yet released. active: released and in use. deprecated: superseded, points at its successor and is kept resolvable. retired: withdrawn tombstone, kept so the identifier stays resolvable. Superseding an artifact flips this field and appends a change_history entry rather than renaming the file.

change_history.description: Append-only change log per IC-8, newest last. At least one entry (the genesis entry) is required. Entries are added, never rewritten or removed.

date.description: ISO-8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the change. This is where the date lives: it appears here, never in the filename.

author.description: The role or person that made the change, per the COMMON role vocabulary.

summary.description: One line describing the change. Carries a MIR-10 reason code where the change is a correction or retraction.

owners.description: Optional accountable owners of the artifact (roles or teams, per the COMMON role vocabulary). Absent means the artifact inherits its owner from the model.

source_layer.description: Optional identifier of the layer this artifact belongs to, for Findings and sub-layer artifacts that resolve upward to an owning layer.
